2. The petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs:
(i) for issuance of writ of Mandamus commanding the respondent authority to vacate the land of the petitioner as it was prior to making the construction of Community Hall, Water Tower.
etc. without acquiring the land under the Land Acquisition Act and even without making the payment of compensation money and without taking consent of the land owner, the petitioner;
(ii) for issuance of writ of Patna High Court CWJC No.4767 of 2018(5) dt.14-05-2024 mandamus commanding the respondent authority, if the authority wants 10 construct the any construction for publie utility over the land of petitioner than the authority may kindly be directed firstly acquire the land under the land acquisition Act and prepare award of the same and to make the payment of compensation price of the land to the petitioner and thereafter may construct the construction in accordance with law and requirement;
(iii) for issuance of writ of mandamus commanding the respondent authority restraining them not to make any further construction completing the same till the final disposal of this petition;
